backupLead.message: Keep a copy outside the browser. An encrypted backup file is safe to store in cloud drive or email.

exportEncryptedBody.message: Protected by a password you choose here. It is separate from your master password, and without it the file cannot be opened.

backupSaved.message: Encrypted backup created. Check that your browser actually saved the file.

exportPlainBody.message: A list of otpauth:// links that anyone can read, including all your secret keys. Use it only to move to another app, and delete it afterwards.

exportPlainCheck.message: I understand this file is not encrypted

plainSaved.message: Plain text list created. Check that it was saved, and delete it when you are done.

importBody.message: Choose a Sixkey backup file. A backup of this same vault is merged; one from another vault adds its accounts here. Exports from other apps open in Add account.

loadedIntoAdd.message: This is not a Sixkey backup. Open it in

expNoPw.message: This vault has no master password for an export to ask for: anyone at this browser can save your secret keys. Turn one on under Security.

expSubBody.message: For a shared or vendor-cloud profile: whoever uses it gets only these accounts. The file has its own password; open it there with Restore or Import.

expSubOnly.message: The file holds only these $1 account(s):

expSubSamePw.message: Use a password other than your master password: whoever opens the file will know it.

expSubSaved.message: File with $1 account(s) created. Check that your browser saved it.

expSubChanged.message: The selected accounts changed in another page. Nothing was saved: check the list and save again.

groupsLead.message: Tick accounts, then move them into a group. Each group is a section of the popup's list; a new group comes last.

groupsSearch.message: Search by name, account or group

groupsCleared.message: Took $1 account(s) out of their groups.
